purpose: Denormalize totalHours to User for leaderboard performance, add future-date validation for event creation, deprecate whyVoluntary in favor of whyVolunteer, replace console.log with winston, fix circular import between logger and env.ts, remove Phase 2 placeholder comments, fix unsafe Prisma type cast, and consolidate import styles across backend/src.
riskRationale: All changes are backward-compatible, well-scoped, and address independent audit findings. The whyVoluntary→whyVolunteer deprecation uses a dual-field acceptance pattern with a graceful fallback. CreateEventSchema/EventSchema split correctly distinguishes creation from update validation. totalHours denormalization updates both User and VolunteerProfile within the same Prisma transactions. The backfill migration copies existing data. No API contracts or DB schemas are broken.
breakingChanges: User.totalHours field added — requires migration to deploy

text: A well-structured PR that cleanly addresses 15 audit findings with focused, minimal changes. The circular dependency fix between env.ts and logger.ts, the CreateEventSchema/EventSchema split, and the backward-compatible whyVoluntary→whyVolunteer deprecation all show good architectural judgment. The backfill migration exists and correctly copies existing data. Two important issues remain (ongoing writes to deprecated whyVoluntary field, EventSeriesSchema duplication of refinement logic) and several minor issues — none blocking merge but worth addressing promptly.

message: Breaking the circular dependency by using process.env directly instead of importing env.ts is minimal and effective. The reconfigureLogger pattern lets env.ts re-initialize the logger after parsing is complete.
Replacing 'as never' with Parameters<typeof prisma.$on>[0] is a fully type-safe fix that carries the correct Prisma event type union instead of silently accepting anything.

Extracting addEventRefinements to share meeting-link and time-ordering validation between CreateEventSchema and EventSchema is clean and DRY. The 5-second grace period on future-date validation protects against clock drift and rapid form submission.

All three totalHours write paths (markAttendance, approveAttendance, checkOut) correctly dual-write to both User.totalHours and VolunteerProfile.totalHours in the same Prisma transaction, preventing data drift.
Well-designed deprecation pattern: logs a single warning when the deprecated field is used, prefers whyVolunteer, with graceful fallback to whyVoluntary for existing clients.
Proper index coverage for both leaderboard sort paths: @@index([points, totalHours]) for points-sorted queries and @@index([totalHours]) for hours-sorted queries.
Migration properly backfills User.totalHours from VolunteerProfile.totalHours and whyVolunteer from whyVoluntary before switching reads. Critical for production data correctness.

Controller writes to the deprecated whyVoluntary field alongside whyVolunteer with the same value. This prevents eventual removal of the column — the deprecated field will never converge to empty/NULL because every registration perpetually re-populates it.
suggestion: Remove the whyVoluntary write and only write to whyVolunteer. The deprecated column retains existing data for backward compatibility but stops accumulating new writes, enabling a future cleanup migration.

message: EventSeriesSchema duplicates the HH:MM time-comparison logic that already exists in addEventRefinements (endH*60+endM > startH*60+startM). Same calculation appears verbatim in both places, creating a maintenance risk — any fix to one must be manually mirrored to the other.
suggestion: Extract the time comparison into a shared helper function used by both addEventRefinements and EventSeriesSchema.

message: BatchData.profile type declares totalHours: number but the actual prisma.volunteerProfile.findUnique query (lines 62-65) only selects bio and currentStreak, not totalHours. At runtime data.profile?.totalHours is undefined, not number — a type inaccuracy that could mask bugs.
suggestion: Remove totalHours from the BatchData.profile type since it is no longer fetched from the VolunteerProfile query.
suggestionCode: profile: { bio: string | null; currentStreak: number } | null;

message: addEventRefinements validates that virtual events require a meetingLink but does NOT validate that in-person events (isVirtual: false) should NOT have one. A client can submit a meetingLink for an in-person event and it will be silently stored, creating contradictory data that downstream code must defensively handle.
suggestion: Add a refinement that rejects meetingLink when isVirtual is false, e.g. .refine((data) => data.isVirtual || !data.meetingLink, { message: 'Meeting link should not be provided for in-person events', path: ['meetingLink'] })

message: VolunteerProfile.totalHours is now write-only dead schema. All reads have migrated to User.totalHours, but events.service.ts still performs dual writes in every transaction. This wastes DB storage and creates maintenance ambiguity about the canonical source of truth.
suggestion: Remove VolunteerProfile.totalHours in a follow-up migration after verifying all write paths only write to User.totalHours.

message: Module-level whyVoluntaryWarningLogged flag persists across tests in the same vitest file. If tests assert on deprecation warning behavior, only the first invocation will fire it, making tests order-dependent. Additionally, in production the warning fires once per process restart — during a slow rollout this means most deprecated submissions go unlogged.
suggestion: Export a __resetModuleState() helper for tests, or use a rate-limited logger call instead of a binary once-per-process flag.

message: reconfigureLogger accepts envNodeEnv: string rather than a typed union ('development' | 'staging' | 'production' | 'test'). This weakens type safety and allows invalid values at compile time.
suggestion: Type the parameter using a literal union, ideally inferred from the env schema to stay in sync automatically.

message: Schema-level tests cover whyVoluntary but not the new whyVolunteer field. Both fields should have equivalent coverage to prevent regressions.
suggestion: Add tests for whyVolunteer: accept within 500 chars, reject over 500 chars, accept when absent.

message: No tests exist for the leaderboard module. The leaderboard query was refactored to use denormalized totalHours, but there are no integration or unit tests verifying the query produces correct results under different sortBy and scope modes.
suggestion: Add tests for getLeaderboard covering both sortBy modes (points, hours), scopes (global, location), and timeframes.

message: Test mocks for prisma.volunteerProfile.findUnique still include totalHours: 5 even though the badge engine no longer reads totalHours from VolunteerProfile. Dead mock values are misleading for future maintainers.
suggestion: Remove totalHours from the volunteerProfile.findUnique mock data.

reasoning: All functional changes are correct, backward-compatible, and backed by a data migration. The backfill migration properly copies existing data. The two important issues (perpetual whyVoluntary write, duplicated EventSeriesSchema logic) are design concerns that don't introduce bugs — they make future cleanup harder. All remaining issues are minor style/test concerns. Low risk, safe to merge.
